people.name: Jesus
people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

translations.web: Jesus spoke this parable to them, but they didn’t understand what he was telling them.
translations.bsb: Jesus spoke to them using this illustration, but they did not understand what He was telling them.
translations.kjv: This parable spake Jesus unto them: but they understood not what things they were which he spake unto them.
